enabled_by_default.label: Enabled by default
enabled_by_default.description: Start keystroke visualizer automatically when Noctalia starts

padding.label: Overlay padding
padding.description: Internal padding spacing inside the overlay around keycaps (in pixels)

margin.label: Keycap spacing
margin.description: Spacing gap between visualized key combinations (in pixels)

timeout_ms.label: Key timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: How long keys remain visible on screen after release (in milliseconds)

max_keys.label: Maximum key combos
max_keys.description: Maximum number of recent key combinations to display simultaneously

badge_style.label: Visual style
badge_style.description: Appearance and background style of on-screen keycaps

show_modifiers_only.label: Shortcuts only
show_modifiers_only.description: Only visualize key combinations containing Ctrl, Alt, Shift, or Super
